title: HM Land Registry public-estate source-family inventory
scope_note: This is a source-family inventory, not a claim that every public HM Land Registry resource has been captured.

source_families.title: GOV.UK Search API records attributed to HM Land Registry
source_families.owner: Government Digital Service and HM Land Registry
source_families.acquisition: Bounded, paginated JSON metadata census; no document bodies or attachments.
source_families.refresh: Snapshot each release; GOV.UK content changes continuously.
known_limits: Attribution to the organisation does not mean every record is current guidance.
Search metadata dates are publication metadata, not dataset currency.
The total can change after the observation time.

source_families.title: GOV.UK Content API
source_families.acquisition: Targeted metadata enrichment for routes already enumerated by GOV.UK Search.
source_families.refresh: Only during a declared snapshot build.
known_limits: Not an independent denominator.
Page bodies and attachments are outside the scaffold boundary.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry organisation, collections and policy pages on GOV.UK
source_families.acquisition: Human-readable authority, collection, service and policy evidence.
known_limits: Collections overlap with Search API records.
OGL applies except where a page or asset states otherwise.

source_families.title: Use land and property data catalogue

denominator.basis: Dataset landing-page entries visible in the catalogue observation

source_families.acquisition: Dataset landing-page and technical-specification metadata only.
source_families.refresh: Monthly or when the catalogue changes.
known_limits: Licences, charges and authentication vary by dataset.
Public catalogue access does not grant bulk-data redistribution rights.
Some downloads are very large and require specialist software.

source_families.title: Use land and property data API v1

denominator.basis: Datasets named by the public API information page

source_families.acquisition: Documentation only; authenticated endpoints are not called.
known_limits: Account, accepted dataset licence and API key are required.
Signed download links are short lived and must never be frozen as public credentials.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry linked-data services
source_families.acquisition: Service and documentation metadata; no unbounded SPARQL crawl.
source_families.refresh: Observe capability and documentation routes at each release.
known_limits: Price Paid Data and UK HPI linked-data models have distinct semantics.
A query endpoint is not a licence for unbounded extraction.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry Business Gateway developer pack
source_families.acquisition: Documentation, schema and service-contract metadata only; no production calls.
source_families.refresh: Observe the exact Git commit used for a release.
known_limits: Most services require Business e-services approval and certificate-based access.
SOAP/WSDL and REST services must not be conflated.
The CDDO API Catalogue is discovery provenance, while this developer pack is operational authority.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry public GitHub organisation

denominator.basis: Public repository count displayed by the organisation page

source_families.acquisition: Public repository metadata through the GitHub API.
source_families.refresh: Snapshot repository metadata at each release.
known_limits: Each repository has its own lifecycle and licence.
Public source code is not automatically production service documentation.
Archived, prototype and fork status must remain visible.

source_families.title: Search for land and property information
source_families.acquisition: Public service-description metadata only; no account creation, search or purchase.
source_families.refresh: Observe GOV.UK service guidance at each release.
known_limits: Sign-in is required.
Documents may be chargeable.
Downloaded copies are not proof of ownership; official copies have a different evidential role.

source_families.title: Search for local land charges
source_families.acquisition: Terms, help and public service-description metadata only; no automated search.
source_families.refresh: Observe public programme, coverage and terms pages at each release.
known_limits: Service terms prohibit automated software agents from searching, copying or monitoring the service.
Reuse beyond conducting a search may require specific consent.
Coverage depends on which local authorities have migrated.
CON29 enquiries remain outside this service.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry portal and Business e-services
source_families.acquisition: Public guidance metadata only; no portal authentication.
source_families.refresh: Observe public guidance and roadmap at each release.
known_limits: Access is for approved professional customers.
Service availability, fees and transaction coverage can change.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry customer help and support
source_families.refresh: Observe contact and support routes at each release.
known_limits: The public forum may contain user-supplied personal or sensitive information.
Forum posts and uploaded files are excluded from acquisition.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry blog
source_families.acquisition: Feed and article metadata are a future bounded lane; no full article bodies in the scaffold.
known_limits: Blog posts explain practice and change but do not replace current formal guidance.

source_families.title: Central Digital and Data Office API Catalogue

denominator.basis: Rows whose provider is hm-land-registry in the frozen live catalogue snapshot

source_families.acquisition: Filter the public CSV by provider and retain its native route and dates.
source_families.refresh: Pin the catalogue commit used for a release.
known_limits: Catalogue rows are discovery metadata and may lag publisher-operated developer documentation.
Licence and authentication fields are often absent.
An older sibling-bundle seed contained 27 HMLR records; the exact live provider-filtered acquisition returned 15 and controls this snapshot.

source_families.title: National Data Library and data.gov.uk discovery records
source_families.owner: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology and contributing publishers
source_families.acquisition: Discovery links and catalogue provenance only.
known_limits: Publisher-operated HMLR pages remain authoritative for access, licence and freshness.
Catalogue dates must not be presented as dataset release dates.

declared_denominators.scope: GOV.UK Search records attributed to organisation slug land-registry
Dataset entries visible on the Use land and property data catalogue
Rows returned by the frozen live CDDO API Catalogue provider filter hm-land-registry
Public repositories returned by the frozen LandRegistry GitHub API census

saturation.test: A second pass added no new critical class of official publishing, transactional, data, developer, support, governance or communication surface.
residual_gaps: No page-level denominator exists across all associated domains.
Authenticated catalogues and service results were not inspected.
Blog posts, customer-help articles and public forum content were not enumerated.
The exact Business Gateway service denominator needs publisher-pack reconciliation.
Dataset landing-page count needs deterministic adapter confirmation.
